thread:
ops-bot: Pager: #incidents — Canary cluster canary-us-west reporting decode errors for model redwood/gpt-release-v3.

sara (eng-oncall): I'm on it. What's the impact?

ops-bot: Error rate increased to 12% over 5m; decoder exceptions show 'INVALID_TOKEN: 0x7f' and several truncated responses. Sample trace: `decode_error at step 32`.

mike (ml-oncall): Checked artifacts — weights promoted as 'v3.1.4-hotfix' but tokenizer alias in the runtime is 'vocab_v2' while release manifest expects 'vocab_v2-alpha'. Looks like a tokenizer alias mismatch.

dan (infra): Log link: https://logs.internal/canary-us-west/1779998888 — deploy events show artifact promotion at 1779998800 referencing tk-8890, weight w-8891.

julia (support): CX reporting garbled assistant replies (ticket #3421). Customers seeing nonsense tokens in responses.

sara (eng-oncall): Marking P1. Immediate mitigation: pause canary via feature flag. @deploy-bot flip `canary-routing-us-west` -> off.

deploy-bot: Feature flag update accepted. Draining traffic from canary nodes.

mike (ml-oncall): While draining, I'll validate pairings: confirm weightset-tokenizer hash alignment and run test in staging.

sara (eng-oncall): Also schedule rollback to last known good model v3.1.3 for canary only. @deploy-bot start rollback job.

deploy-bot: Rollback job rb-1779 started for group canary-us-west. Nodes restarting with target version v3.1.3.

dan (infra): Health checks returning green as instances come up on v3.1.3.

mike (ml-oncall): Local inference against v3.1.3 + vocab_v2-alpha looks normal. Decoder hash matches expected: sha256:aa12bb33cc.

julia (support): Notifying affected customers: "We've paused the canary and rolled back to the previous stable model. We're investigating the root cause and will update." Posting now.

sara (eng-oncall): Can we confirm the bad promotion step? What broke in pipeline?

mike (ml-oncall): Promotion logs show `promote --alias vocab_v2` executed instead of `vocab_v2-alpha`. Likely a race in tag assignment during CI artifact staging.

sara (eng-oncall): Action items: mike to add artifact-pair validation in release pipeline; dan to add deploy-bot preflight to block promotions when tokenizer/weights mismatch; julia to follow up with customers and update tickets.

mike (ml-oncall): Opening PR to add validation and a unit test for artifact alias checks: https://git.internal/ml/release/PR-432

dan (infra): I'll implement a gating check in deploy-bot: block if `tokenizer.alias != weights.expected_tokenizer_alias` and return actionable error message.

julia (support): Confirmed recovery with CX — affected sessions resolved. I'll draft post-incident customer note for review.

sara (eng-oncall): Incident status: mitigated (canary rolled back, traffic restored to control). Keep thread open until PRs merged and deploy-bot change in place.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-1779 created; severity P1; linking postmortem template.

mike (ml-oncall): Root cause summary for postmortem: artifact promotion mistakenly applied wrong tokenizer alias due to concurrent tag update during CI -> mismatch at runtime causing decode failures.

sara (eng-oncall): Good. Update the incident doc when PRs merge. Handing off to follow-up team for remediation and postmortem.

julia (support): I'll close CX tickets after the postmortem note is published.

sara (eng-oncall): Thanks team. /close when postmortem is linked.
